purpose: Design new styles from recovered compiled UI evidence
evidence: Shipped compiled QML; branch-free expressions are decoder inferences, bytecode preserves unresolved branches

measurement.warning: Do not compress Y alone or assume full-width fit. Main uses uniform model-dependent scale, rotation, and margins.

main_loader.limit: Model identity, current screenFlipEnabled, and runtime margins require device state. No physical overlay asserted.

navigation.menu: Shared menu Loader: center X; top 220; scale 0.85; active menuBarIndex; 100 ms scale animation
navigation.vehicle_state: Public visual bindings use mGlobalId.item fields. Preserve field names in each component specification.
navigation.controls: Dashboard key_back, key_ok, key_left, key_right, key_up, and key_down functions preserve recovered bytecode where present.
navigation.scope: Public dashboard, common visual components, and assist widgets. Factory, update, credential, and private configuration components excluded.

cruise_contract.acc_visibility: cruiseState; SET uses cruiseSpeedSet; ACC car branch uses cruiseAccInterfaceState
cruise_contract.limiter: getCruiseLimSpeed() and getCruiseLimSpeedColor(); limiter and cruise use separate state fields
cruise_contract.design_requirement: Use one shared cruise region across all six styles. Preserve available, engaged, set-speed, ACC, and LIM meanings. Consolidate alarm 31 after the vehicle-state mapping is verified.
cruise_contract.uncertainty: Native numeric enum meanings and live CAN transitions remain unproved.

unit_preferences.status: PC source candidate; active loader and vehicle verification remain pending
unit_preferences.manual_selection: Assign the selected Global value, then call mEventHandleId.item.setUnit2(type, value). Preserve the other unit preference.
unit_preferences.mode_display: Show Manual when the corresponding override flag equals 1. Show Follow vehicle when the flag equals 0.
unit_preferences.reset_action: Expose mEventHandleId.item.followVehicleUnits() in the ordinary Units menu. The action clears both overrides and adopts cached vehicle units.
unit_preferences.clock: Retain native RTC unit follow. Unit selection must preserve unrelated settings.

settings_navigation.requirement: Expose supported settings through ordinary menu navigation without credential gates.
settings_navigation.factory_inventory: factory-settings.json contains all 19 recovered configuration rows.
settings_navigation.unsupported_features: Keep unsupported entries visible with a clear reason. Never fabricate vehicle data or enable an unverified protocol.
settings_navigation.integration_status: Navigation requirements; the source candidate does not replace the compiled factory menu.

design_contract: Preserve speed, unit, gear, alarm, cruise/limiter, and vehicle data semantics across all styles.
Use genuine assets through the local manifest. Keep alarm colors and active/inactive distinctions from binding evidence.
Keep hidden states quiet. Reserve visual emphasis for active warnings.
Do not infer gauge sweep, tick marks, maximum values, or native enum meanings from schematic rectangles.
Treat every model branch, visible condition, animation, unit conversion, and menu state as a separate visual acceptance case.
render_limits: Schematics show constant bounds, not actual screenshots.
No vehicle sample data or invented gauge geometry appears in the schematics.
Runtime branches, native custom types, implicit text metrics, loaded data, and state-dependent transforms need reconstruction.
Asset prefix matches are candidate sets, not proof that every candidate appears simultaneously.
